## Current status

| Surface | State |
|---|---|
| Documentation and public contracts | Phase-1 candidate |
| Installable/importable package and version metadata | Phase-1 product scaffold target |
| `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented |
| `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented |
| Common run/handoff and profiles | Planned; not implemented |
| Unified reports | Planned; not implemented |
| Notebook interfaces | Planned; not implemented |

The docs-first repository base is empty of product code. This site therefore
does not provide installation or execution instructions yet.

## Near term

1. Land and validate the package/version scaffold.
2. Define the common artifact, profile, receipt, and handoff models.
3. Implement Palace Electrostatic and Eigenmode, emphasizing Surface EPR.
4. Implement version-locked PyAEDT paths for HFSS Eigenmode, HFSS Driven
   Modal/Terminal, Q3D, and Q2D.
5. Add notebook contracts and Plotly reports only as real APIs become available.

## Later

- Palace Driven
